name: Shattered Crown
description: A broken crown of rock rises over six lands: an ash basin with lava runs and a stone arch, a sunken fen, the Thornwood hills, snowbound Frostfang with its ice tunnel and overhanging ledge, the ruined keep on the Kingsroad and a deep river gorge under a high bridge. 2 to 6 players, best with 4 to 6.
